tasks.title: Validate the port recipe with one real port
tasks.note: PlagueRat ported, built, spawned, saved and reloaded intact. Both draft fidelity traps were wrong (range perception was backwards; ServUO ignores its own speed args) and are corrected in notes/port-recipe.md. Three of the five F3 patches exercised at runtime: bandage-on-PetMimic and talisman durability both work; MAKE X works with no button overlap but its label uses an HTML colour where AddLabel wants a hue, so it renders invisible. See notes/cc1-p1-runtime-validation.md. Open: Q-008 (speed model), and new evidence on Q-007 (forcing SHA2 breaks new-account login on the live shard).

tasks.title: Second port, timed, using only the recipe
tasks.note: GreaterPoisonElemental ported headlessly in about 20 minutes end to end. Phase split: orientation <=1:00, selection+source read 4:51 (2:51 net), transformation 0:40, failed build 1:00, dependency resolution 2:12, clean build 0:44, verification 9:21. A warm build cycle is 44s and per-file work is ~1:10, so build cycles are NOT the dominant cost - the transformation and the dependency decisions are. Estimate for a batch of 20: about one hour. Biggest finding: measured across all 462 Mobiles/Normal files, only 60% are clean - 19% reference a type ModernUO lacks and 29% call SetWeaponAbility/SetSpecialAbility/SetMagicalAbility/PetTrainingHelper. Draw C4 batches from the clean 60%. Full write-up in notes/cc2-timed-port.md; recipe corrected. Opened Q-010 (LuckyCoin deviation), Q-011 (AGENTS.md wrongly calls server/uo a full ModernUO checkout; the Docker builder image is the real offline source), Q-012 (the tameable cohort is not a straight port).
